description: Blade work at a level that ends fights before they start.
Draw and cut as one motion. The first strike is usually the only one.
Close-quarters shooting that moves like a martial art.
Two weapons, two targets, no pause between them.
Leaves an afterimage where the body was. Pursuers commit to the wrong one.
Crosses open ground in the gap between glances.
Contact alone is a dose.
Survives what she administers.
Thrown weapons land where she looked.
Unarmed, and still the most dangerous thing in the room.
Steps into shadow and is not there any more.
Turns a dark room into the enemy of whoever is standing in it.
Talks past a checkpoint that has been told not to let anyone past.
A knockout that looks better than it has any right to.
Belongs to whichever crowd he is currently standing in.
Treats a city as a route rather than a set of walls.
Starts fires without a source. Ending them is somebody else’s job.
The mark hands it over and thinks it was their idea.
Drops the temperature of a room until it stops working.
A weapon that melts before anyone can log it into evidence.
Solves the problem loudly and takes the building with it.
Gets the vehicle out, in whatever condition.
Field surgery under conditions no hospital would accept.
Stabilises the worst of it long enough to move.
Gives away nothing, including whether there is anything to give away.
Tracks odds nobody else is tracking.
Conditioning that outlasts the mission.
Keeps a wounded agent on their feet until extraction.
Statistically implausible. Repeatedly.
Buys the rest of the team the seconds they need.
Sees the answer while everyone else is still reading the question.
Trades a known loss for a better position.
Leaves no trace in any system she has touched.
Opens what is locked electronically.
Builds the needed device out of whatever is on the table.
Carries more than should fit.
Moves what she cannot reach.
Knows the answer before the lie is finished.
Reads a document once and can reproduce it.
Produces papers that survive inspection.
